backlog.growth_rule: every successive mean grows; net growth exceeds max(1, offered operations per second)

acceptance_policy.latency_boundary: queue-inclusive recall p95 in every repeat, both backends and workloads

metrics.host_identity_boundary: hash of locally observed hostname, OS and architecture; not attestation
metrics.measurement_boundary: scheduled arrival to parent receipt; includes dispatch, IPC, queue, engine call and canonical verification; excludes startup/seeding
metrics.memory_boundary: sampled simultaneous RSS sum of runner and descendants from before seeding through engine startup, workload and teardown; shared pages may be counted more than once; not an allocation high-water mark

backlog_assessment.reason: burst workload has no sustained offered rate
backlog_assessment.rule: five active-arrival windows with at least two samples each; every successive mean grows and net growth exceeds one second of offered arrivals

backlog_observations.boundary: scheduled-due minus parent-received operations; includes dispatch, IPC, running work and verification

observation_limits: sampled RSS peaks can miss transients between observations
shared resident pages may be counted in more than one process
exited or inaccessible descendants can be omitted from a sample
phase is captured at sample start; collection can cross a phase boundary
runner Python/model allocator retention contributes to later phase RSS
GPU memory and cold OS cache are not measured

metrics.startup_boundary: fresh process and connection with warm OS page cache
unmeasured: full 48-cell paired matrix and confidence intervals

token_accounting.method: named regex counter; not provider billing
